summary_en: 7,100,712 shares (40.8% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) acquired at ¥257/share for ¥1,826.9B via tender offer. Offer period 2026-05-13 to 2026-07-02 (37 business days). Minimum threshold 5,186,700 shares met. Target becomes consolidated subsidiary and specified subsidiary effective settlement date 2026-07-09.
title_en: Notice of Tender Offer Results for Anshin Guarantee Co., Ltd. (Securities Code 7183) and Subsidiary Change (Specified Subsidiary Change)
translation_en_brief: Muninova Holdings completed a tender offer for Anshin Guarantee Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, code 7183) on 2 July 2026, after launching the offer on 13 May 2026. The offer targeted ordinary shares and specified warrants (the Sixth Series warrants issued 9 August 2016, exercisable through 9 August 2026). The tender price was ¥257 per ordinary share and ¥1 per warrant. The minimum acceptance threshold was 5,186,700 shares; no upper limit was set. The offer was conditional on meeting the minimum. Total applications received: 7,100,712 shares, exceeding the minimum, so all tendered securities were acquired for a total outlay of ¥1,826,915,584 (computed as 7,100,712 shares × ¥257). The 7,100,712 shares represent 40.8% of Anshin Guarantee's shares outstanding (ex-treasury), calculated as 7,100,712 ÷ 17,392,018 shares ex-treasury = 40.8%. Settlement occurs 9 July 2026, upon which Anshin Guarantee becomes a consolidated subsidiary and specified subsidiary of Muninova Holdings.
